JAX@BAL.text: Lamar Jackson is out and third-stringer Joe Fagnano starts. Vegas noticed: Baltimore went from lookahead favorite to a 10-point home dog.

CIN@ATL.text: Joe Burrow leads the NFL at 302.1 passing yards a game. Michael Penix Jr. ranks 32nd of 35 starters in completion % over expected. Olé.

CLE@NO.text: The 2-5 Saints have yet to win a home game this season, and Vegas still has them favored over the 5-3 Browns.

DAL@IND.text: The Colts have lost four straight, including a 42-7 beatdown in Jacksonville. Dallas has dropped three of four. Somebody has to win this.

DEN@CAR.text: The Broncos are 4-0 against the spread as favorites. Carolina's run defense ranks 28th in yards per carry allowed. Yikes.

DET@MIA.text: The 1-6 Dolphins are 0-3 at home, and Jahmyr Gibbs just ran for 153 yards. Hard Rock, meet hard running.

LA@WAS.text: The Rams are 7-3 ATS in their last 10 against Washington, which ranks 31st in opponent rush success rate and has Terry McLaurin on IR.

NYG@PHI.text: Joe Milton III becomes the Eagles' third starting QB this season with Jalen Hurts on IR. Philly has lost six straight, so no pressure, Joe.

NYJ@KC.text: The Chiefs were 5-0 a few weeks ago; now they've lost two straight, with Kenneth Walker averaging 2.6 and 3.3 yards per carry in them.

HOU@LAC.text: The Chargers are 0-7 straight up and 0-6-1 against the spread. Not a single cover all year. Impressive, in its own way.

LV@SF.text: Kirk Cousins has 19 TD passes and the Raiders are 6-2 against the spread. Yes, those Raiders.

ARI@SEA.text: Sam Darnold is out (quad), so Drew Lock likely starts. Lock threw three TD passes at Arizona in Week 2. The Cards remember.

GB@NE.text: The Under is 5-0 in Green Bay's last five games. The Over is 5-0 in New England's last five. Something has to give.

TB@CHI.text: The Bucs blanked Atlanta 16-0 without completing a single pass. Bucky Irving's 728 rushing yards: apparently all you need.

BUF@MIN.text: Kyler Murray is out with a hamstring strain, so Carson Wentz starts for the 6-1 Vikings, and the line slid toward Buffalo. Bring it, Carson.

WAS@NYG.text: Round one ended in a tie because Washington ran out of clock in overtime. Meanwhile, the Giants have covered six of eight.

NE@DET.text: The Over is 6-0 in New England's last six games, while the Under is 3-0 in Detroit's last three. One streak dies in Munich.

BUF@NYJ.text: The Jets have allowed 26+ points in four straight losses, and Buffalo is 5-0 against the spread in the last five meetings. Rough neighborhood.

CAR@NO.text: Saints DE Chase Young has eight sacks in eight games, second in the NFL. Panthers linemen, consider yourselves warned.

HOU@CLE.text: The Texans are 0-4 at home but 3-1 on the road. Lucky for them, they're in Cleveland, where the Browns are 3-0.

JAX@TEN.text: Trevor Lawrence threw for 484 yards and five TDs in two games against the Titans last season. The 1-7 Titans remember.

KC@ATL.text: Bijan Robinson leads the NFL with 880 rushing yards, which is about the only thing the 3-6 Falcons are leading.

MIA@IND.text: Daniel Jones has thrown an interception in eight of nine games, including four straight. Dolphins DBs, bring your gloves.

MIN@GB.text: Kyler Murray (hamstring) remains week-to-week, so Kirk Cousins starts at Lambeau. Packers fans know that face.

LA@ARI.text: With Gardner Minshew doubtful, Carson Beck gets his first NFL start. The Rams' Puka Nacua is listed as doubtful.

SEA@LV.text: Heisman winner Fernando Mendoza makes his first NFL start for the Raiders, while Seattle stays without Sam Darnold. Rookie welcome party, Vegas style.

SF@DAL.text: CeeDee Lamb dropped 195 receiving yards last week. Brock Purdy has a TD pass in eight straight. Defense is optional.

PIT@CIN.text: Both teams are 6-2 riding four-game win streaks, with the AFC North lead on the line. Pittsburgh won the first one 30-27.

LAC@BAL.text: The 0-8 Chargers are 0-7-1 against the spread. The Ravens are 2-7 ATS and without Lamar Jackson (IR). Something has to give.

IND@HOU.text: The Texans are 0-4 against the spread at home and just blew a 17-0 lead to Cleveland. Vegas still has them as big favorites.

ARI@KC.text: Arizona hasn't scored a TD since opening November in Dallas. Patrick Mahomes has 10 TD passes and zero picks in his last three games.

BAL@CAR.text: Lamar Jackson is on IR, and the Ravens are a wallet-draining 2-8 against the spread this season.

JAX@NYG.text: The Giants are 5-3-1 without facing a team currently in a playoff spot. Enter the 7-2 Jaguars.

MIA@BUF.text: Miami's only win this season came against the Jets. Now the 1-8 Dolphins visit an 8-1 Bills team that's 7-2 against the spread.

NO@CHI.text: Caleb Williams threw four interceptions last time out. The Saints' defense would love an encore after the Bears' bye week.

TB@DET.text: Jahmyr Gibbs piled up 252 scrimmage yards in Germany and became the first RB to 1,000 yards. The rested Bucs get the next shift.

TEN@DAL.text: Dallas allows 28.2 points a game, Tennessee 26.6. Both defenses rank bottom six, which explains that 54.5 total.

NYJ@LAC.text: The Chargers are 1-8 against the spread, and the Jets' red zone offense ranks dead last. Somebody has to cover.

LV@DEN.text: The Raiders are 8-2 against the spread in the last 10 meetings with Denver. The 7-2 Broncos are fresh off a bye anyway.

PIT@PHI.text: The Eagles have lost seven straight and are 1-8 against the spread. The Linc could use some good news.

MIN@SF.text: The UNDER is 8-1 in Vikings games this season. Kirk Cousins and Minnesota take that snooze act to Mexico City.

CIN@WAS.text: Joe Burrow is completing 74.7% of his passes, yet Washington has won the last three meetings with Cincinnati.
